about: Film-only launch-state data for the NavisLabs launch film V7. Every entity the film shows comes from this file. NavisLabs and Abhishek Meena are real and authorized; every customer, contact, colleague, record and number here is SYNTHETIC demo data. No real company is shown as a customer: a web search (2026-10-06) found no publicly named NavisLabs customer or design partner (navislabs.in says only that it is 'deployed with a small group of design partners').
names_policy: Real and authorized: NavisLabs (the organization, Bengaluru) and its founder Abhishek Meena. Everyone and everything else is SYNTHETIC. The customer is a fictional Indian company, Kaveri Freightworks (Bengaluru logistics) — a web search on 2026-10-06 found no company with that exact name; it is labelled fictional in the end-card disclosure. No real company (Tata, Reliance, Infosys, Zerodha, Razorpay, PhonePe, Flipkart, Swiggy, Zomato, Digantara, …) is shown as a customer. Mulayam Kumar and Digantara are not used: the dataset has no written authorization for either.
